lines.say: The hip thrust. Is it the best glute exercise?
Your glutes do almost all the work, pushing your hips up.
Your hamstrings and quads help a little.
In muscle activity tests, hip thrusts light up the glutes more than squats.
But in a twenty twenty three study, squats and hip thrusts built about the same glute size.
So pick the one you enjoy. Or do both.
Chin tucked, ribs down, and squeeze hard at the top.
